md.summary: Environmental conditions are becoming less conducive to thunderstorms capable of producing tornadoes. Parts of the remaining valid portion of Tornado Watch 679 could be locally extended an hour or so in time this evening, but a new tornado watch is not anticipated.
md.discussion: Cool surface ridging is maintaining a considerable influence across much of the southern Mid Atlantic, as far south and west as portions of the northeastern South Carolina coastal plain into the Piedmont, where near surface lapse rates remain isothermal or more stable. Strongest low-level shear is focused within the cooler air, and forecast to become increasingly modest within the moist sector through this evening. Coupled with at least subtle boundary-layer cooling within the moist sector over the next couple of hours, the risk for convection capable of producing tornadoes seems likely to diminish by or not long after 11/00Z, even as upstream mid-level troughing slowly pivots east-northeast of the lower Mississippi Valley.
